subject: Downstream subprocessor addition: Order Form mapping & DPA evidence
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@edgecloud.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, contracts@acmeplatform.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: proposed downstream subprocessor (LogStream) + questionnaire attached

Hi Kimberly and team,

EdgeCloud is planning to add a downstream subprocessor, LogStream Solutions, to assist with realtime log enrichment for the order ingestion pipeline. We wanted to provide early notice and surface the materials you typically need for a subprocessor approval:

- Short description: LogStream will receive ephemeral log objects (no PII) to append enrichment tags for routing.
- Location: US-only processing (us-west regions).
- Security posture: SOC 2 Type II in progress (expected completion Q3).

Attached: EdgeCloud_Subproc_Notice_v1.pdf and the EdgeCloud_Applicant-Questionnaire.xlsx (please complete the questionnaire where Redwood needs specific evidence).

We expect this change to be reflected in the Order Form as a flow-down (Annex A mapping) + minor DPA amendment to list LogStream as an authorized subprocessor. Can you confirm the information you need from our side and whether the proposed scope triggers any order-form redline requirements?

Happy to jump on a short call if that helps — suggested window Thu-Fri this week.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Legal Ops | EdgeCloud
LegalOps@edgecloud.ai

Maria — thanks for the heads up and for sending the questionnaire. Quick notes / asks from Redwood: 

1) Please confirm the DPA version you intend to flow down (EdgeCloud DPA v2026-11 or a bespoke annex). We need the exact clause mapping so Legal can confirm equivalence.
2) Order Form mapping: call out which Order Form sections you want LogStream to be listed under (Annex A/subprocessor appendix) — we typically amend the Order Form via an addendum and DocuSign route.
3) Evidence: final SOC 2 report (or SOC interim), penetration test summary, and confirmation of encryption at rest + KMS provider.
4) Security requests: will LogStream support SSO/SAML for admin console? Any access review cadence?

I've looped in Jonas (legal) for redline and procurement (Priyom) for procurement/ops impact. If you can complete the questionnaire and share the SOC artifact, we can triage internally and aim to respond formally by Monday 2027-05-10.

Short call is fine — Thu 5/6 10–10:30 PT works on our side. Please send an agenda and a docusign link for the order-form amendment if available.

Subject: Re: Notice: proposed downstream subprocessor (LogStream) + questionnaire attached

Kimberly / Maria — quick legal triage after initial review. Highlights we need to resolve before approval: 

- Indemnity & Liability flowdown: the Order Form addendum must include an explicit indemnity flowdown for third-party processing claims tied to LogStream actions. Current EdgeCloud language omits cascade indemnity; propose adding a residual clause.
- Breach notification window: your DPA notes 72 hours; Redwood standard requires 48 hours for known subprocessor incidents affecting customer data. We can be flexible if EdgeCloud adds a mitigation plan with SLA credits.
- Audit & rights to inspect: we need audit rights (or reasonable access) to any material changes to LogStream's controls and subcontracting. A quarterly attestation is acceptable if SOC report is delayed.
- Data residency: you stated US-only; add explicit contractual guarantee and routing restrictions in Order Form Section 3.2.

I've prepared a redline draft for the Order Form (OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf) that maps the subprocessor list to Annex A and adds two short clauses: 1) 48-hour breach notice; 2) indemnity cascade language (limited carveouts). Can EdgeCloud confirm acceptance or propose alternate language?

If we can't reach quick alignment, suggest an approval lane where Procurement grants conditional operational onboarding (limited access/dev environment) pending final DPA addendum and SOC evidence. That keeps onboarding moving without full production access.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 11:05 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:

Regards,
Jonas Weber
